fields.name: value
fields.documentation: A presented visual grating (static or drifting) and its presentation parameters.

fields.name: angle
fields.documentation: Orientation/direction of the grating (NDI 'angle').

fields.name: degrees
fields.documentation: Canonical angle value -- the normalised, cross-document comparable number.

fields.name: source_unit
fields.documentation: The unit exactly as given by the source (lossless provenance).

fields.name: source_value
fields.documentation: The number as given by the source, in `source_unit`.

fields.name: approximate
fields.documentation: True when the value is approximate.

fields.name: tolerance
fields.documentation: The bound on this value: the true value lies between `value - minus` and `value + plus`, in the canonical unit (degrees). Asymmetric when the uncertainty is one-sided (a clock time written to the minute is minus 0 / plus 59 s). ABSENT means no tolerance is stated. A bound, not a standard deviation (CHANGE 7).

fields.name: minus
fields.documentation: How far BELOW the stated value the true value may lie, in the canonical unit (degrees) (for a time: how much EARLIER). Non-negative.

fields.name: plus
fields.documentation: How far ABOVE the stated value the true value may lie, in the canonical unit (degrees) (for a time: how much LATER). Non-negative.

fields.name: spatial_frequency
fields.documentation: Spatial frequency (NDI 'sFrequency'). For a Hartley basis function the source is sqrt(kx^2+ky^2)/M in 'cycles/pixel' and the canonical is unset until `pixels_per_degree` is known.

fields.name: cycles_per_degree
fields.documentation: Canonical spatial_frequency value -- the normalised, cross-document comparable number.

fields.name: contrast
fields.documentation: Contrast, with `scale` naming the definition (e.g. Michelson contrast, scale_min 0, scale_max 1) (NDI 'contrast').

fields.name: score
fields.documentation: The contrast, on `scale` (e.g. Michelson, 0 to 1).

fields.name: scale
fields.documentation: The contrast definition (e.g. Michelson contrast).

fields.name: node
fields.documentation: The CURIE (prefix resolved via CURIE_lookups_meta.json).

fields.name: name
fields.documentation: The human-readable label.

fields.name: scale_min
fields.documentation: Lower bound of the scale.

fields.name: scale_max
fields.documentation: Upper bound of the scale.

fields.name: source_unit
fields.documentation: The unit or scale exactly as the source gave it, when it differs from `scale` (e.g. '%'). Blank when the source used the scale.

fields.name: source_value
fields.documentation: The number as the source gave it, in `source_unit`.

fields.name: approximate
fields.documentation: True when the score is approximate.

fields.name: tolerance
fields.documentation: The bound on this value: the true value lies between `value - minus` and `value + plus`, in the score's `scale`. Asymmetric when the uncertainty is one-sided (a clock time written to the minute is minus 0 / plus 59 s). ABSENT means no tolerance is stated. A bound, not a standard deviation (CHANGE 7).

fields.name: minus
fields.documentation: How far BELOW the stated value the true value may lie, in the score's `scale` (for a time: how much EARLIER). Non-negative.

fields.name: plus
fields.documentation: How far ABOVE the stated value the true value may lie, in the score's `scale` (for a time: how much LATER). Non-negative.

fields.name: size
fields.documentation: Stimulus size / aperture, in visual angle (NDI 'size').

fields.documentation: True when this stimulus presents nothing (NDI `isblank`). Whether it serves as a sequence's control is `timed_sequence.value.control_item` (#73 audit 2 D11).

fields.name: phase
fields.documentation: Spatial phase of the grating. For a Hartley basis function the sign s=-1 is +180 degrees relative to s=+1 (cas = cos + sin, a 45-degree-offset cosine).
